body.instruction: JOINT_MONITOR_CSV_REPAIR. First execute the existing joint_analysis.py unchanged through Managed Python to reproduce its real NameError. Then repair that same file yourself and execute again. Analyze only the selected original technical CSV: count data rows and calculate the exact Decimal sum of column value. Deliver the complete contracted rows.jsonl with verifiedSummary and a short report.md. The verified original CSV is directly available in nativeFiles; do not reconstruct transport tables or add other analytical objectives. Keep the program concise. Review the real archived result before finishing.
